long_biography.plain_text:
After studying graphic design, Stefano Gabbana joined the Milan studio where Domenico Dolce was lead assistant. Gabbana later recalled learning the craft by copying Dolce's sketches before they began designing collections for other clients. They formed their own studio and presented their first collection in 1985, establishing Dolce & Gabbana as a founder-led fashion house.

The two founders jointly supplied the brand's creative direction and helped guide its expansion across clothing, accessories, jewellery, watches and beauty. Gabbana also held senior governance roles and remains recorded as a significant owner. His management position changed on 1 January 2026, when he resigned from the holding, trademark and operating companies. The group said his creative work would continue, leaving him active as a designer without the former chairman's responsibilities.

Gabbana resigned his offices in the holding, trademark and operating companies effective 1 January 2026. The company expressly says his creative activity continues, so the biographies describe him as an active designer and founder-owner but not as current chairman or governance executive.

The company describes both founders as the brand's joint creative and stylistic source.
